o.text:
Etymology tree
Arabic اِعْتَبَرَ (iʕtabara)
Arabic اِعْتِبَار (iʕtibār)bor.
Azerbaijani etibar
Borrowed from Arabic اِعْتِبَار (iʕtibār), from اِعْتَبَرَ (iʕtabara).
From Proto-Turkic *yügen. Cognate with Bashkir йүгән (yögän), Chuvash йӗвен (jĕven) etc.
From Proto-Common Turkic *sagïsgan (“magpie”). Cognate with Bashkir һайыҫҡан (hayıśqan), see it for more cognates.
From Proto-Turkic *yaĺ- (“to cover, close”). Cognate with Uzbek yashirmoq, Kazakh жасыру (jasıruw), Kyrgyz жашыруу (jaşıruu). Compare also Yakut сас (sas, “to hide”).
Borrowed from Russian шо́у-би́знес (šóu-bíznes), from English show business.
